vertical_bar_progressive.purpose: Hold raw | form constant or closely related while increasing/altering context and symbol role.

exclamation_fixity.purpose: Same glyph/run with prefix, postfix, and unresolved tokenization.

tilde_context.purpose: Same glyph; prefix operation versus infix relation.

circle_context.purpose: Same filled-circle form; topology modifier versus bullet.

nabla_dilation.purpose: Shared operator nucleus resolved by adjacent marks and operand type.

inverse_attachment.purpose: Same superscript attachment resolved against target semantic type.

arrow_context.purpose: Same arrow token at graph versus type-system level.

backreference_context.purpose: History/capture dependent symbols whose meaning points to an earlier symbolic object.

whole_bearer_override.purpose: Distant bearer-scoped legend establishes symbol meaning across the preserved whole bearer.
